articles.title: Bitcoin's record holder supply hides a buyer drought, CryptoQuant says
articles.snippet: A record high in long-term holder supply typically signals conviction. CryptoQuant says it reflects a shortage of new buyers, a view echoed by weakening ETF demand and bearish prediction market odds.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s major holders halt buys as demand slows: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant says that the holding structure for large Bitcoin holders is deteriorating, a trend that has historically preceded “sustained price weakness.”
